entities.name: Oret
entities.description: A cartographer on Tarkir and Anafenza's cousin, an Abzan traitor in both timelines.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: Orc krumar who survives the fortress attack and serves Anafenza (original timeline); a Kolaghan orc in the current timeline.

entities.name: Kwaro
entities.description: Captain of the guard present at Anafenza's ceremony.

events.summary: In the original timeline, Oret hires a Sultai assassin whose zombie mastodons topple the family's rolling fortress.
events.quote: Oret had hired Sultai assassin who used four zombie mastodons to topple the entire fortress

events.summary: Years later Anafenza, now khan, disowns the traitor Oret in a blood rite.
events.quote: Performing a blood rite before the First Tree and the eyes of their ancestors, she disowned him.

events.summary: In the current timeline Oret follows Anafenza into the desert and personally kills her to save her spirit.
events.quote: To save her spirit, Oret personally killed her, allowing her soul to stay with the ancestor spirits nearby.

events.summary: Oret arrives at Kavah as a hero but is honored as cartographer, a life in exile.
events.quote: honored with the title of cartographer, and, with it, a life in exile

events.summary: Oret gathers amber and places it around a dead tree, preserving Anafenza as a warrior spirit.
events.quote: Oret ensured that Anafenza lived on as a fierce kin-tree warrior spirit.

events.summary: Oret is banished from House Mevak.
events.quote: had earned him banishment from House Mevak and severance from their Kin-Tree

relations.quote: Oret is a cartographer in Tarkir , and cousin of Anafenza .

relations.note: Killed her in the current timeline to save her spirit.
relations.quote: To save her spirit, Oret personally killed her

relations.note: Her captain in the current timeline.
